BiblicalUsage: Pirathon is a town in Ephraim, in the mount of the Amalekites. It is named once, in Judges 12:15, as the place where Abdon the son of Hillel died and was buried — the judge who followed Jephthah, laid to rest in his own town.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God honours a judge by naming his home town, not only his battles.
